digest.component_or_area: Jira DC mutations / parent field handling
propositions: Clearing a sub-task's fields.parent is not supported by Data Center, but clearing an Epic Link on a standard-issue child is reachable and now verified to work end-to-end.
The three permanent reds in the live DC suite are three distinct problems with different root causes and dispositions; treating them as one platform limitation was incorrect.

Parent-clear operations must be primed through LOCAL rebar edits to establish the ref as MANAGED so should_propagate_removal fires; Jira-side creation does not reliably establish rebar as the manager.

The blocking unknown — whether {epic_link_field_id: None} actually clears on DC 8.17.1 — was already answered by existing green cells in run 30951453979; the probe confirmed serverInfo 200 is not readiness for Jira Software custom fields.

The re-homed cell test_outbound_clear_parent_round_trips moved from clearing fields.parent on a sub-task to clearing Epic Link on a standard-issue child, passed green on live run 30964805133, and now asserts the operation through real reconcile pass code paths.
The non-sub-task branch of set_parent lacks read-back verification unlike the sub-task branch; this gap is real but not currently masking failures, so it is deferred as a separate hardening.
